transition_gap.reason: repair transition excluded from both windows

comparison.interpretation: The same pages-build population remained extremely cancellation-heavy in both windows. The post window has a modestly lower cancellation rate, but this observational delta does not establish that the Agent Runtime trigger repair caused total Pages churn reduction.

writer_suppression_truth.proven_narrow_effect: A coordination/portfolio evidence commit after the trigger-scope repair produced Prometeo Live Feed + Prometeo Engine runs and no Prometeo Agent Runtime v3 run, proving suppression of that redundant writer path.
writer_suppression_truth.aggregate_pages_churn: Still severe in the comparable post window; not eliminated.
writer_suppression_truth.causal_limit: Do not attribute the aggregate cancellation-rate delta to the Agent Runtime repair without controlled counterfactual evidence.
